searchText: Is this for sepolia or mainnet? I thought sepolia happened on May 1 but this comment making me doubt 🙂 https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/953349957400821860/1368957391877570580 nimbus-eth1 does have experimental support using `--history-expiry=true` and you can mention block height using `--debug-history-expiry-limit=<blockNumber>` Though this works only for sepolia and mainnet, but we can extend the support for custom networks Besu also has the flag `--Xsnapsync-synchronizer-pre-merge-headers-only-enabled=true` and block height can be set in the genesis file

excerpts.content:
nimbus-eth1 does have experimental support using `--history-expiry=true` and you can mention block height using `--debug-history-expiry-limit=<blockNumber>`
Though this works only for sepolia and mainnet, but we can extend the support for custom networks
